result: I’d realign the foundational incentives of human systems so that long-term collective flourishing and ecological balance become the default, not the exception. Almost every global challenge stems from structures that reward short-term extraction, division, and growth-at-all-costs, even when they quietly erode the conditions that make prosperity possible. If economics, governance, and cultural narratives naturally made cooperation, stewardship, and intergenerational wisdom the path of least resistance, survival, equity, and innovation would stop competing with each other and start reinforcing one another. It wouldn’t erase human complexity or difference, but it would make sustaining life together the easiest thing to build upon.
